pkgbase = nwipe
	pkgdesc = A fork of the dwipe command that will securely erase disks using a variety of recognised methods
	pkgver = 0.43.1
	pkgrel = 2
	url = https://github.com/martijnvanbrummelen/nwipe
	arch = x86_64
	arch = aarch64

	depends = hdparm

	depends = ncurses

	depends = libnvme
	optdepends = coreutils
	optdepends = dmidecode
	optdepends = smartmontools
	source = https://github.com/martijnvanbrummelen/nwipe/archive/v0.43.1.tar.gz

pkgname = nwipe

# Maintainer: robertfoster
# Contributor: <kfgz at interia dot pl>

pkgname=nwipe
pkgver=0.43.1 # renovate: datasource=github-tags depName=martijnvanbrummelen/nwipe
pkgrel=2
pkgdesc="A fork of the dwipe command that will securely erase disks using a variety of recognised methods"
arch=('x86_64' 'aarch64')
url="https://github.com/martijnvanbrummelen/nwipe"
depends=('hdparm' 'libconfig' 'ncurses' 'parted' 'libnvme')
optdepends=('coreutils' 'dmidecode' 'smartmontools')
license=('GPL-2.0-or-later')
source=("${url}/archive/v${pkgver}.tar.gz")

build() {
  cd "${srcdir}"/${pkgname}-${pkgver}
  ./autogen.sh
  ./configure --prefix=/usr
  make
}

package() {
  cd "${srcdir}"/${pkgname}-${pkgver}
  make DESTDIR="${pkgdir}" install
}

sha256sums=('134169dc2b0e11c1d3d6ea9c3d03b2dd0a69151cfb612e39ab17a81fd64eb02f')
